answer: Escalating bond per funding source: the nth account funded from one source posts 10 POA, doubling each time (10, 20, 40...), so ten sybils cost 10,230 POA versus 10 for one, about 1,023x. The nadir is the first account's base bond; the ridge starts at account five, where cost passes 150. Weakness: attackers spread funding across sources; fix: peers merge sources sharing counterparties into one walnut cluster, billed as one.
